prose: Vercel, Cloudflare and others are moving quickly to add Jev, a model that makes AI tool selection much faster and cheaper, Forbes reports. TypeSafe says Jev matches GPT-5.6 and Sonnet 5 on workflow evaluations, targeting the reality that most of what an AI agent asks a frontier model to do is choosing - which tool to call next, whether to retry, whether a command is safe - rather than writing.
highlights: Vercel, Cloudflare and others are quickly integrating Jev.
Jev focuses on fast, cheap tool selection for AI agents.
